To my young brother, 
   If you're reading this, then you know what has happened, and you likely have doubts in your heart. I thought about this for a long time and made up my mind. For many years, I blamed the death of Father Li on my adoptive father. Recently, through the master, I discovered that I had been harboring my hatred for the wrong person. Father Li was killed by a single phrase from the government: "When there are no more birds, the bow becomes useless." I had been in the wrong for many years and assisted the culprit. The kindness of my adoptive father and the revenge for Father Li... I bear both on my shoulders. 
   Only by destroying the ship can I put an end to this. Now I can go see Father Li. 
   Please fulfill my wish by stopping the hatred and not coming with me. Take care of yourself, and put on more clothes when the weather gets cold.
